title: Kurnool authorities approve immersion of Ganesh idols at Handri-Neeva canal amid water shortage
description: Following the impact of El Nino, the water levels in K-C canal had come down drastically, forcing authorities to announce that the immersion could not take place there, as priority is given to the storage of drinking water; Bharath says officials have assured that all necessary arrangements will be made to facilitate the immersion of large idols as well
